release_notes.stringValue:
• Advanced Player Comparison: Side-by-side head-to-head stats comparison for batting, bowling, and fielding performance
• Faster Live Scoring & Scorecards: Snappy ball-by-ball scoring updates and real-time scorecard refresh
• Enhanced League Chat & Media: Smoother messaging, video sharing, and real-time league updates
• Reliable Cloud & Gully Sync: Instant match backups, global player stats reconciliation, and multi-device sync
• Material 3 UI & Stability: Polished UI dialogs, smoother app startup, and overall performance bug fixes
